## Appearance

Mrs. Allan possesses a lovely smile. Her cheeks feature exquisite dimples when she smiles.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P9](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0009)_

## Personality

Allan is described as a bright, gentle, and sweet individual who serves as a cheerful and sympathetic visitor. Though known for her gay demeanor, she admitted to having been a dreadful mischief who frequently got into scrapes as a girl.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P25](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0025), [v3 ch.Weddings P46](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0046)_

## History

Mrs. Allan arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) five years prior as a new bride alongside her minister husband, having grown up as a self-described mischievous girl who was a dunce at geometry. During a tea party at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she graciously comforted a mortified [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after the girl mistakenly flavored a cake with liniment, taking an interest in Anne's flower garden instead. In times of tragedy and reflection, Mrs. Allan provided comforting counsel to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) following Matthew's death and later shared a walk home with her to discuss teaching, life choices, and the value of friendship.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P43](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P45](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0045), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P49](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0049), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P54](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0054), [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. ## Quotes

> "and we should have a very high ideal of it, and never sully it by any failure in truth and sincerity. I fear the name of friendship is often degraded to a kind of intimacy that has nothing of real friendship in it."
>
> — Allan — [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P46](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0046)

> “My dear little girl, you mustn’t cry like this,” she said, genuinely disturbed by Anne’s tragic face. “Why, it’s all just a funny mistake that anybody might make.”
>
> — Allan — [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P50](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0050)

>
> — Allan — [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P31](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0031)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Mrs. Allan serves as a valued friend and mentor to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), offering gentle guidance and acting as a comforting presence. Their friendship deepens early on when Mrs. Allan kindly comforts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after a embarrassing baking mishap involving a liniment-flavored cake, and Mrs. Allan later provides spiritual and emotional support following Matthew's death. Over the years, the two share meaningful conversations on topics ranging from teaching ideals and life choices to memory and the enduring value of friendship.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006), +25 more_

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--shirley.md)

Mrs. Allan shares a close friendship with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), trusting her enough to confide deeply personal matters. Their bond is marked by emotional intimacy, including Mrs. Allan sharing her grief with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) regarding her deceased baby.
